eps.d: Bliss and his colleagues investigate the Duboys family, whose members have been known to live for up to 150 years. They soon become embroiled in a series of murders involving the remaining members of the family.
Sam is working on a malaria vaccine, but the work is suspended when a student dies during trials. When a second student dies, Sam decides to investigate.

Whilst travelling by train, Zoe sees a girl die from multiple stab wounds. Sam reports the matter to the police, but they can find no evidence to support her story. The next day, a murder occurs exactly as Zoe described.

Sam discovers that even though a boy suffers from fits, blackouts and mood swings, his mother will not take him to see a doctor. When he discovers that the boy has severe bruising, he decides to take matters into his own hands.
